Easton Town Center 🏈 Michigan Week · Black Friday
Monday November 23 – Sunday November 29, 2026
Michigan week. Thanksgiving Eve Wednesday, Black Friday at 8 AM, and The Game Saturday at noon.
The biggest weekend of the fall. Easton is closed Thanksgiving Day, then opens Black Friday 8 AM to 9 PM. Saturday: Michigan at Ohio Stadium, noon on FOX — 100,000 in town and everyone else watching somewhere. Blue Jackets are home Wednesday and Friday, the lights run every night 5 to 11. Cold, rain on Thursday, dry and 50° for The Game.
